conclusion: Both frozen theorems A/B including thresholds, physical source, and weighted gate statements are proved as written. No repair required.
limits: An ordinary-octave probability law, a positive-mass dominated gate transfer, and a quantified all-start obstruction for C<1/log(2). Collatz escape and nontrivial cycles remain open.
separate_extension: The reflected normalized cylinder mass has an exponential-error limiting constant; ordinary octave upper tails have sharp two-sided power order; scaled deviations are tight.
